title: einvoice conformance coverage (v1)
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema for the coverage matrix emitted at einvoice/coverage_matrix.json by einvoice/gen_coverage.py. This is the artifact a buyer reads to answer 'does it fire the rules my German ERP needs, in my CI?': it enumerates every EN 16931 / XRechnung business rule the engine actually asserts (proven by test_coverage_matrix.py against the live rule registries, not aspiration), the pinned official Schematron sources each was differentially proven against, the German-message coverage, the credit-note conformance headline, and the honestly-reasoned exclusion / gap / rule-family breakdowns. It carries no rule logic itself and adds no rule claim beyond what the code fires. Versioning policy: this coverage matrix does not embed a numeric version field; the schema/shape version is carried by the $id path segment (v1). Additive, backward-compatible keys may be added within v1; a breaking change bumps the $id to v2. The top-level key set is described strictly (additionalProperties:false); deep, artifact-specific inner blocks are described by type where their key sets legitimately vary, so the schema stays faithful without over-constraining honest additive detail. Subschemas are inlined (no $ref).

artifact.description: Human label naming the artifact ('einvoice conformance coverage matrix').

description.description: Human prose describing what the matrix reflects (what the code fires, not aspiration).

generated_by.description: The generator that emitted this file (gen_coverage.py, derived from the live rule registries + differential.py graded sets).

schematron_sources_order.description: Stable ordering of the Schematron source keys.

schematron_sources.description: The pinned official Schematron artifacts, keyed by source id (e.g. 'en16931-ubl', 'xrechnung-cii'). Each entry pins the suite, file path, version and license.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the pinned Schematron artifact.

german_message_coverage.description: How many rules carry an official German (de) human message and where those messages surface.

official_message_de_count.description: Rules carrying a verbatim official German message.

total_rules.description: Total rule count for the ratio.

surface.description: Where the German message is exposed (CLI/report human message with --lang de; not in --json).

source.description: Provenance of the German text (verbatim from the vendored KoSIT XRechnung Schematron).

other_rules_policy.description: Policy for rules without an official German message (never machine- or hand-translated).

creditnote_conformance.description: The credit-note (BG-25/UNCL1001 381) conformance headline, kept SEPARATE from the invoice headline.

graded_rule_count.description: Rules graded on the credit-note leg.

known_open.description: Map of known-open credit-note rule ids to reasons (empty when none).

unit_corpus_graded_cases.description: Credit-note unit corpus cases actually graded.

unit_corpus_agree.description: Cases where the engine agrees with the oracle.

distinct_rules_exercised.description: Distinct rules exercised by the credit-note corpus.

differential_divergences.description: Differential divergences on the credit-note leg (0 == full agreement).

separate_from_invoice_headline.description: True to flag that this metric is reported separately from the invoice headline.

rules.description: One entry per asserted business rule, with the syntax it fires in, its blocking severity, the raw official @flag, and the per-syntax (UBL/CII) Schematron provenance.

family.description: The rule family (free string; the closed set is not guaranteed stable).

syntax.description: Which syntax(es) the rule fires in.

severity.description: Blocking severity derived from the official @flag.

provenance.description: Per-syntax Schematron provenance for this rule (both `ubl` and `cii` keys are always present; a key may explain, via `reason`, why a proof is impossible in that syntax).

differentially_proven.description: True iff differentially proven to fire in UBL.

reason.description: OPTIONAL: prose explaining a non-proof (e.g. the rule has no UBL binding, or the shipped assert is vacuous).

asserts.description: OPTIONAL: the concrete Schematron assert ids this rule maps to when split across asserts.

note.description: OPTIONAL: a human note on a non-1:1 mapping.

differentially_proven.description: True iff differentially proven to fire in CII.

asserts.description: OPTIONAL: the concrete Schematron assert ids this rule maps to when split across asserts.

note.description: OPTIONAL: a human note on a non-1:1 mapping.

exclusions.description: The honestly-reasoned set of official assertions the engine deliberately does NOT count as fired, grouped by reason category. Each category's entries carry per-rule ids and reasons; the inner shapes vary by category (e.g. `official_tautology` carries evidence), so they are typed by container here.

vacuous.description: Asserts that can never fire as shipped (vacuous), with id + reason.

official_tautology.description: Asserts shipped as tautologies (e.g. test="true()"), with id, official text, reason and per-artifact evidence.

codelist_not_asserted.description: Code-list checks the engine does not assert, with id + reason.

cii_core_out_of_scope.description: CII core-model out-of-scope rules, with id + reason.

cii_de_out_of_scope.description: CII German out-of-scope rules, with id + reason.

gap.description: The gap analysis: for each official artifact universe, how many rules are implemented / excluded / missing, and which non-business-rule asserts were set aside.

artifact_order.description: Stable ordering of the gap artifact keys.

excluded_ids_considered.description: The excluded rule ids the gap math accounts for.

artifacts.description: Per-artifact universe/implemented/missing counts (keys are the artifact ids; inner counts described by the emitter).

kosit.description: CIUS-layer gap universes for the two vendored KoSIT XRechnung artifacts (additive within v1): per artifact, the fireable BR-DE-*/BR-DEX-*/BR-DE-CVD-*/BR-TMP-* assert universe partitioned into implemented vs documented-exclusion ids with zero unclassified remainder, recomputed live and guarded by test_coverage_gap.py.

description.description: What the KoSIT gap block means.

family_prefixes.description: The id prefixes defining the CIUS-layer family universe.

artifact_order.description: Stable ordering of the KoSIT artifact keys.

artifacts.description: Per-artifact universe/implemented/documented-exclusion partition (keys are artifact ids; inner counts described by the emitter).

peppol_kosit_family.description: The Peppol/KoSIT vendored rule-family breakdown: labelled per-artifact universe/implemented/known-open counts and the implemented id list.

artifact_order.description: Stable ordering of the artifact keys.

artifacts.description: Per-artifact family counts (keys are artifact ids).

known_open_worklist.description: Known-open family rule ids still to implement (empty when none).

cvd_tmp_family.description: The XRechnung CVD-tmp rule-family breakdown (same shape as peppol_kosit_family): labelled per-artifact counts and implemented id list.

artifact_order.description: Stable ordering of the artifact keys.

artifacts.description: Per-artifact family counts (keys are artifact ids).

known_open_worklist.description: Known-open family rule ids still to implement (empty when none).
